const root = listDir();
const src = listDir("src");
console.log("root:", root.map(e => `${e.kind}:${e.name}`).join(", "));
console.log("src:", src.map(e => `${e.kind}:${e.name}`).join(", "));
return { rootCount: root.length, srcEntries: src };
